criteria.description: GET /health returns 200 with a body indicating the database is connected, against a live Postgres instance
criteria.verification: curl http://localhost:<port>/health returns 200 with JSON body { status: "ok", db: "connected" } while Postgres (via docker-compose) is running

criteria.description: Backend has one passing automated test covering the health check
criteria.verification: backend/src/routes/health.test.js passes under `npm test` in backend/

criteria.description: Frontend renders a landing page showing the Ignite Petroleum logo (cropped lockup, not the raw padded JPEG), app name, and applies the theme tokens
criteria.verification: manual: `npm run dev` in frontend/, load the page in a browser, confirm public/logo-full.png renders without a visible background-color mismatch box, heading text is present, and background/primary colors match the theme tokens

criteria.description: Frontend has one passing automated test covering the landing page render
criteria.verification: frontend/src/App.test.jsx passes under `npm test` in frontend/

criteria.description: Lint passes with zero errors in both services
criteria.verification: `npm run lint` exits 0 in backend/ and in frontend/

criteria.description: CI runs lint + test for both services on a PR, with a live Postgres service for the backend job
criteria.verification: .github/workflows/ci.yml defines a postgres service container and runs backend+frontend lint/test jobs; verified green on the PR opened for this task

criteria.description: Root README documents local setup and run steps for both services, including the database
criteria.verification: README.md contains prerequisites, backend setup steps, frontend setup steps, and how to run tests for each
